processor-info.script: String cmd = input.getText("cmd"); executeSQL(cmd, connection, input, output);

sql.query: select is_date, ist_title, is_ill, iplace,fmt_is_date,stime,etime,jisaname,start_yn,end_yn,ing_yn from ( select top(50) a.schedule_id, CONVERT(CHAR(10), is_date, 23) as is_date, ist_title, is_ill, iplace, CONVERT(CHAR(8), is_date, 112) as fmt_is_date, convert( char(5), stime, 8 ) stime, convert( char(5), etime , 8 ) etime, replace(b.jisaname, '지회', '' ) jisaname, case when ( cast( srcv_date as datetime) - getdate() +1 ) <= 0 then 'Y' else 'N' end as start_yn, case when ( cast(ercv_date as datetime) - getdate() -1 ) <= 0 then 'Y' else 'N' end as end_yn, case when cast(srcv_date as datetime) <= getdate()-1 and cast(ercv_date as datetime) >= getdate()-1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as ing_yn from TB_EDCT_SCHEDULE a, tb_apc_company_sub b where a.ji_code = b.ji_code and a.use_yn = 'Y' and CONVERT(CHAR(8), is_date, 112) >= ? + '00' order by is_date asc )a order by is_date desc

select is_date, ist_title, is_ill, iplace,fmt_is_date,stime,etime,jisaname,start_yn,end_yn,ing_yn from ( select top(50) CONVERT(CHAR(10), is_date, 23) as is_date, ist_title, is_ill, iplace, CONVERT(CHAR(8), is_date, 112) as fmt_is_date, convert( char(5), stime, 8 ) stime, convert( char(5), etime , 8 ) etime, replace(b.jisaname, '지회', '' ) jisaname, case when ( cast(srcv_date as datetime) - getdate() +1 ) <= 0 then 'Y' else 'N' end as start_yn, case when ( cast( ercv_date as datetime) - getdate() -1 ) <= 0 then 'Y' else 'N' end as end_yn, case when cast( srcv_date as datetime) <= getdate()-1 and cast(ercv_date as datetime) >= getdate()-1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as ing_yn from TB_EDCT_SCHEDULE a, tb_apc_company_sub b where a.ji_code = b.ji_code and a.use_yn = 'Y' and CONVERT(CHAR(8), is_date, 112) >= ? + '00' and CONVERT(CHAR(8), is_date, 112) <= ? +'31' order by is_date desc )a order by is_date desc

select CONVERT(CHAR(10), is_date, 23) as is_date, ist_title, is_ill, iplace,CONVERT(CHAR(8), is_date, 112) as fmt_is_date from TB_EDCT_SCHEDULE where CONVERT(CHAR(8), is_date, 112) = ? and use_yn = 'Y' order by is_date desc
